name: Shopify
description: Shopify for Claude makes starting, running, and growing an online store as easy as having a conversation. Turn a small business idea into an ecommerce website with Shopify’s AI store builder: describe what you sell, create your store, add products, and sell online. Already have a Shopify store? Connect it to manage inventory across locations, create discount codes, review orders and customer details, and pull analytics on your store’s performance. Shopify supports selling online, in person, B2B, on marketplaces, and selling internationally. Whether you run a print on demand business, sell digital products, operate an online boutique, dropship, or serve wholesale buyers, Shopify gives you the foundation to build, sell, and grow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Shopify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Shopify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://setup.shopify.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Shopify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shopify lists 25 MCP tools, including search_products, get-shop-info, get-product, create-product, update-product, list-orders, get-order, list-customers, get-inventory-levels, set-inventory, create-discount, and add-to-collection.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Shopify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Shopify in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Shopify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Shopify is developed by Shopify. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
